spec: Implement module sequence101(input wire clk, rst, din, output reg match). All state changes only on rising clk. rst is active-high synchronous and has priority. State before the first reset edge is unspecified. Registered serial 101 detector. Reset clears history and match. After each nonreset rising edge, match=1 iff the last three nonreset sampled bits are 1,0,1. Overlapping matches allowed (10101 gives two pulses). Fewer than three bits since reset cannot match.
